correctness.rationale: For every smooth ordered normal-form pair over the algebraic closure of F5, the coefficient matrix of F(x)^2 on regular differentials diagonalizes over F5 with eigenfactors P+, P-, R. Frobenius-semilinearity thus gives stable rank equal to the number of nonzero factors. The factor identities produce four lines and two hyperbolas. Characteristic-five resultants (a+2)^6(a^2+2a-2) and (a-2)^6(a^2-2a-2), plus P+-P-=4(a+b), isolate all six smooth double intersections. Their Jacobians are nonzero and no triple intersection occurs (R=2 on P+=P-=0). Exact symbolic replay and independent GF25 enumeration (506 smooth, with ranks 3/2/1 counted 380/120/6) succeeded. The infinite result follows algebraically, not from the finite enumeration.

originality.rationale: Ohashi 2021 gives the normal form and conditional maximality of superspecial curves, while Moriya--Kudo 2022 develops Richelot constructions and superspecial enumeration. Known nonexistence of superspecial hyperelliptic genus-three curves for p=5 is not claimed as new. Neither inspected paper establishes the characteristic-five nonordinary divisor as four lines plus two hyperbolas or its six reduced transverse rank-one parameters. The accessible comparable characteristic-seven classification is arithmetically distinct and cannot imply the characteristic-five coefficient equations. Searches did not uncover an equivalent classification; unindexed earlier computations remain a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed coefficient-level calculation may already establish the same p=5 Hasse divisor and six rank-one intersections.
The searched literature and research records cannot prove uniqueness or complete priority.

value.rationale: The complete natural arithmetic stratification has structural content beyond the known superspecial nonexistence: the characteristic-five Hasse divisor splits into exactly four line and two hyperbola components, with a precisely determined six-point reduced rank-one intersection scheme over F25. It exhibits how three elliptic quotient Hasse factors interact inside a two-dimensional genus-three locus and is a reusable degeneration example. The explicit incidence classification and field-of-definition statement, rather than a routine single invariant or numerical substitution, supply the mathematical reason for studying this exact normal form.
